name: Typographic
description: No photography at all. The composition is built entirely from type, rules and fields, with meaning carried by scale relationships, spacing and colour. Fully controllable and free of image-generation risk.
spacing: Every interval derives from a single base unit tied to the body size. Space is the only compositional material available, so inconsistency is immediately visible.
responsive_behavior: The column count reduces rather than the type scale. Line breaks are set deliberately for each ratio because ragged endings carry meaning in a type-only composition.
